summary: Help desk: the 3 most-asked answers up top, topic buttons that filter the list, all 19 questions tap to open (now with the 2027 registration discount windows, the 2027 scholarship note and Challenger ages), then an email card for anything else.
blurb: Answers to the questions families ask most, sorted by topic.
notes: Typos fixed: scholarship email presdent@ is now president@, #13 now points to #8 instead of #7. The 2027 registration windows show in the Most asked panel (short form) and in a Spring 2027 box at the top of answer #1; answer #1 keeps the board's general wording below it.

sources.fact: The Night Out with the Rainiers raffle raised enough to continue the scholarship program for the 2027 season.
Challenger Division is adaptive baseball for players with physical and intellectual challenges, ages 4 to 18 (up to 22 if still in school); questions to vpchallenger@blslittleleague.org.

Spring 2027 registration windows (board motion passed Nov 1): Black Friday sale Nov 27 to 29, $50 off per family; Early Bird Nov 30 to Dec 31, $25 off per family; full price from Jan 1, 2027. Minutes are up for board approval Dec 6.
